dedupe_keys.name: ile de france historic land use and road network layers about 1700 to 1994

description: Institut Paris Region (L'Institut Paris Region, regional planning agency) publishes ten schematic layers of land use in five classes and of the road network at several dates from about 1700 (the Chasses map) to 1994 (the simplified land-use inventory captured at 1:50,000), derived from historic maps, made to quantify how territories and infrastructure developed over time. Coverage: Île-de-France; the 1900 layers cover only the nine 1:50,000 map sheets centred on Paris (from Melun to Meaux and from L'Isle-Adam to Corbeil); layers were last modified on 2021-09-06. Format and access: CSV, shapefile, GeoJSON and KML downloads plus ArcGIS REST feature services, without registration from the Institut Paris Region open data hub. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Licence ouverte (Etalab Open Licence); cost: free. Caveats: the layers are schematic and built from different source maps, so successive dates are not strictly comparable; coverage differs between dates. Simulation uses: long-term urban growth and network development baselines for land-use change, infrastructure expansion and exposure trend studies. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
